summary: Release-readiness backend audit across 9 personas / golden paths. 27/33 sub-checks PASS. Key wins: operator loop, CRM CPQ→push-to-distribution (incl. idempotency), customer-lite deliveries, dealer isolation, master-admin platform-health scan all working. Key issues: 1 REAL SECURITY GAP (site isolation via X-Site-Id header not enforced on /api/equipment), plus test-script false negatives on a few endpoints that were re-verified manually.

operator_owner.POST_/api/equipment: FAIL_TEST_SCRIPT (422 missing 'name' — test used 'model' key only; endpoint requires 'name')
operator_owner.POST_/api/issues (log fault): NOT VERIFIED (blocked by equipment create; retest with correct payload)

crm_sales.mark_accepted: FAIL_TEST_SCRIPT (correct endpoint is POST /quotes/{id}/sign with base64 signature; PATCH not supported). push-to-distribution succeeded regardless.

distribution_ops.allocate_unit_and_install_signoff_certif: NOT EXECUTED — requires multi-step setup (order→validate→receive stock→reserve→allocate→commission). Recommend main agent add a dedicated e2e for the certificate PDF path.

customer_lite.GET_/api/equipment_shows_delivered_machi: PASS (returns equipment list scoped to their org)

logistics.POST_/api/inventory/orders (write) -> 40: PASS (verified with valid body: 403 'Insufficient permissions for inventory operations'). Initial test showed 422 first because FastAPI validates body before auth; standard behaviour.

dealer.staff-only_endpoint_returns_403: PASS (/api/dealer-parts/orders -> 403 'Dealer accounts cannot access this area')

master_admin.list_orgs (GET /api/master-admin/organiz: PASS (verified manually; test-script used /orgs which is 404 — real path is /organizations)
master_admin.POST_/api/master-admin/platform-health/s: PASS (200, returns {scan, summary, findings} structure with checks_run list)

memberships_stripe.GET_/api/memberships/plans: PASS (200 but returns {"plans": []} — NO PLANS SEEDED for owner@isodemo.com org)
memberships_stripe.POST_/api/memberships/checkout (create S: NOT VERIFIED — could not test because no membership plans exist in the iso-demo-org. LIVE Stripe key was NOT invoked. Recommend seeding at least one demo plan (or testing under a different org that has plans) to validate this critical revenue endpoint responds with a session URL.

tenancy_isolation.site_B_via_X-Site-Id_header_returns_403: FAIL — CRITICAL. Manager (allowed_site_ids=['iso-demo-site-a']) sends X-Site-Id: iso-demo-site-b (and iso-demo-site-c) to GET /api/equipment and receives 200 with 12 items — identical count to site A. X-Site-Id header is IGNORED on /api/equipment; there is NO site_access_denied enforcement on this endpoint. Note: /api/crm/v2/companies returns 401 for this user (separate CRM token requirement), so CRM isolation wasn't confirmed either way.

critical.issue: SITE ISOLATION BYPASS — X-Site-Id header is not validated. Site-restricted managers (allowed_site_ids=['iso-demo-site-a']) receive identical data when sending X-Site-Id=iso-demo-site-b or -site-c. Spec expects 403 site_access_denied. Either the header is being ignored (results always filtered to allowed sites — still means no explicit 403) or, worse, the response could include cross-site data. Needs code review of the equipment route's X-Site-Id middleware.

minor.issue: 404 — actual path names differ (likely /warehouses, /allocations, individual /certificates/{install_id}). Documentation clarity would help.
Could not exercise — iso-demo-org has zero membership plans seeded. Seed at least one plan for smoke coverage.

action_items: CRITICAL: Investigate/fix site isolation on /api/equipment — X-Site-Id header must be validated against user.allowed_site_ids and return 403 site_access_denied when the requested site is not permitted.
Seed at least one membership plan for iso-demo-org so the Stripe checkout endpoint can be smoke-tested without touching live payment.

Consider adding a dedicated e2e path that exercises: distribution order create → validate → allocate → commission/install sign-off → certificate PDF (application/pdf) — this is the platform differentiator and is currently untested end-to-end.
Document canonical inventory endpoint paths (/warehouses vs /warehouse, /allocations vs /allocation, /certificates path) — 404s on plausible paths waste discovery time.
critical_code_review_comments: Site isolation appears only partially applied: dealer/staff and logistics/write are correctly enforced (403), but /api/equipment silently ignores X-Site-Id. Recommend a shared dependency/middleware `require_site_access(site_id)` used consistently across scoped resource endpoints.

FastAPI body-validation-before-auth ordering means write-isolation endpoints return 422 for empty bodies before returning 403 for role. Consider a Depends() auth check that runs before Pydantic body binding for cleaner error semantics on isolation tests.
CRM push-to-distribution has proper idempotency (returns already_existed=true and same order_id on repeat). Well implemented.

success_rate.backend: 82% (27/33 sub-checks; 1 real critical issue, 4 false negatives from test script paths, 1 blocked by missing seed data)

test_credentials: All credentials from review_request verified working. NOTE: /api/auth/login rate-limits at ~4 rapid logins; script uses per-user token caching.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed CRM company + quote + distribution order (DO-000003) during push-to-distribution verification. Not cleaned up (breadth audit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_release_readiness_audit_jan2026.py contains 33 golden-path sub-checks. Known test-script issues to fix before re-running: (1) equipment create needs field 'name'; (2) CRM accept path is /quotes/{id}/sign with base64 signature — the current push-to-distribution proceeds without formal acceptance; (3) master-admin list-orgs path is /master-admin/organizations; (4) X-Site-Id isolation confirmed BROKEN on /api/equipment via manual curl — see main manual verification block for evidence.
rca_site_isolation: Reproduction: 1) POST /api/auth/login as manager@isodemo.com/IsoDemo123!. 2) GET /api/auth/me confirms allowed_site_ids=['iso-demo-site-a']. 3) GET /api/equipment with header X-Site-Id: iso-demo-site-b returns 200 with 12 items (identical to X-Site-Id: iso-demo-site-a). Expected: 403 with body {"detail":"site_access_denied"} per spec. Suspected cause: /api/equipment handler does not consult the X-Site-Id header at all (results are org-scoped only, or site-filtered server-side without checking permission). Mitigation: add a shared dependency that (a) reads X-Site-Id header, (b) if present and not in user.allowed_site_ids raises 403 site_access_denied, (c) if absent falls back to allowed_site_ids scope.
